content:
jord: Heads up: customer noticed duplicate confirmed credits after a reconnect+truncated toolcall. Small spike but they want explanation.

jord: quick trace:
```
conn session=klm-9 last_ack=200
model emitted toolcall tc-9 truncated seq 201..210 final=false
router lost conn -> resume on router-c replay seq 205..210 provisional +6
later reconcile confirms original tc-9 and we end up with confirmed +6 twice in CSV
```

vika: Do we currently include toolcall_id in provisional ledger keys? If not that's an easy win.

trevor: We include (session, seq-range) but router id not normalized. Different routers can race and write overlapping ranges. Reconciliation clears it but CSVs expose it.

jord: Short-term: add an ingress conditional upsert keyed on (session, toolcall_id, start_seq, end_seq) with a 30s lookback to avoid races. Also add metric provisional_upsert_conflict.

vika: UX: Console should show a tiny "provisional visible" toggle on billing export page and a tooltip: "Provisional rows are interim and may be reconciled later." That reduces support noise.

trevor: Rollout plan: FF at 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Watch provisional_upsert_conflict and provisional_confirmed_duplicates. If conflicts > duplicates massively, good. If under-reporting observed, revert.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-801 for tenant remediation.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 1805557000 for ingress-guard-v1

jord: Follow-ups: 1) PR for upsert (trevor), 2) Console toggle mock (vika), 3) metrics+dash (trevor). Sync tomorrow morning.
